name: Intelligent Inventory Management System
description: An intelligent web-based inventory management platform designed to streamline asset tracking, inventory lending, complaint management, and damaged asset monitoring, enhanced with AI-powered complaint clustering and an intelligent virtual assistant.
problem: Traditional inventory management processes lacked centralized asset monitoring, automated complaint analysis, and structured damaged asset reporting. Manual complaint classification made it difficult to identify recurring issues, recognize damage patterns, and generate actionable inventory insights.
solution: Developed a modular inventory management platform using Golang, Gin Framework, PostgreSQL, and Bootstrap 5 with Clean Architecture principles. Implemented AI-assisted complaint clustering to identify recurring complaint patterns, structured damaged asset reporting and monitoring, and an AI-powered virtual assistant to support users in accessing inventory information and system guidance.
impact: Enhanced inventory visibility, streamlined complaint management, improved damaged asset monitoring, and introduced AI-driven insights to support more informed inventory management decisions.
deliverables: Clean Architecture Backend using Golang and Gin Framework
PostgreSQL Database Design and Entity Relationship Diagram (ERD)
RESTful API for Inventory and Asset Management
Asset Lending and Return Management Module
Complaint Management and Tracking Module
AI-Powered Complaint Clustering and Classification Feature
Damaged Asset Reporting and Monitoring Dashboard
AI-Powered Virtual Assistant for Inventory Information and User Support
Interactive Inventory Dashboard and Data Visualization
Responsive Web Interface using Bootstrap 5 and JavaScript

name: Stock Price Forecasting Using Machine Learning
description: A prototype stock price forecasting system designed to analyze historical financial data and predict future stock prices using multiple statistical, machine learning, and deep learning algorithms.
problem: Stock market volatility and complex price movements make it challenging to accurately forecast future stock prices. Traditional forecasting approaches may not fully capture nonlinear patterns and relationships between historical prices, trading volume, and external economic indicators.
solution: Developed a machine learning-based stock forecasting prototype with an automated data preprocessing and modeling pipeline. Implemented and compared six forecasting algorithms: ARIMA, ARIMAX, Random Forest, XGBoost, LSTM, and GRU. Integrated historical stock market data with external economic indicators, including BI Rate and USD/IDR exchange rates, to evaluate predictive performance across different modeling approaches.
impact: Demonstrated the effectiveness of machine learning and time-series forecasting for stock price prediction through comparative model evaluation. Achieved a best experimental MAPE of 0.65% using the ARIMAX model, providing insights into model performance and forecasting accuracy.
deliverables: Stock Price Forecasting Prototype
Historical Stock Market Data Collection and Preprocessing Pipeline
Comparative Evaluation of Six Forecasting Algorithms
ARIMA and ARIMAX Statistical Forecasting Models
Random Forest and XGBoost Machine Learning Models
LSTM and GRU Deep Learning Models
Model Performance Evaluation Report (MAE, RMSE, and MAPE)
Jupyter Notebook for Data Analysis and Model Development
Stock Price Prediction and Forecast Visualization

name: OBE-Based Academic Assessment System
description: A web-based academic grading system prototype designed to support Outcome-Based Education (OBE) implementation through structured academic assessment, grade management, and student learning outcome evaluation.
problem: Manual academic grading processes and fragmented assessment records can create challenges in managing student performance, maintaining assessment consistency, and evaluating learning outcome achievement in OBE-based academic environments.
solution: Designed and developed a web-based academic assessment prototype using Golang, Gin Framework, GORM, and PostgreSQL. Implemented a modular backend structure with dedicated controllers, services, models, and routing components to support academic data management and assessment workflows.
impact: Established a functional prototype for centralized academic grade management, providing a foundation for more structured assessment processes and the integration of OBE-based learning outcome evaluation.
deliverables: Academic Assessment System Prototype
Golang Backend Application
Modular Backend Architecture
Academic Data Management Components
PostgreSQL Database Integration
RESTful Backend Routing
Web-Based Academic Assessment Interface
key_features: Course Learning Outcome (CLO) & Program Learning Outcome (PLO) Mapping
Student Grade Input and Performance Evaluation
Modular RESTful API Services with Clean Layer Separation
Centralized Academic Assessment Reporting & Grade Export
